verdict.rationale: Plausible's own docs describe built-in funnel analysis: you define a sequence of steps, see how many visitors complete each one, and find where people drop off. Funnels can be sequential or strict-order, steps can be pages or custom-event goals, and a user-journeys view shows the paths visitors take. The dashboard is pitched as usable with no training, which fits a founder answering this without an analyst. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of funnel use, and evidence that funnels can track user-level activation across sessions or days rather than per-visitor website flows.

support.subject: As a founder, I can answer "which activation step loses users?" myself with funnels and drop-off analysis, without an analyst

citations.quote: Define a sequence of steps and measure how many visitors complete each one. Use funnel analysis to find where people drop off and improve your conversion rate.
Choose between two funnel types: sequential (visitors can take other actions between steps) or strict order (steps must happen in exact consecutive order)
Measure drop-off across a fixed sequence of steps. Or explore the paths visitors actually take to discover flows you didn't predict.
easy to use and understand with no training or prior experience
